Direktorat Jenderal Pajak: Multitarif, era baru PPN Indonesia — standard rate 11% from April 2022 under the HPP Law (Law 7/2021), 10% before

PMK 131/2024 (JDIH Kementerian Keuangan): 12% VAT from 1 January 2025 — charged on the full base for luxury goods (LGST) and on an 11/12 'other value' base for everything else, keeping the effective rate at 11%

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

From 1 January 2025 the nominal rate is 12%, but PMK 131/2024 charges it on an 11/12 base for everything except luxury goods, so the effective general rate stays 11%; luxury-goods supplies to end consumers paid the transitional effective 11% during January 2025 and the full 12% from 1 February 2025.
